## History

Mary Joe was a healthy, wide-faced French girl from the creek who was hired by Mrs. [Pembroke](../character/pembroke.md) to look after her children while the parents were away. While the [Pembroke](../character/pembroke.md) parents were absent, the young baby sister, [Posy Fay](../character/posy-fay.md), contracted croup. [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md) had to seek outside help to treat the child during this period.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Nell to the Rescue P1](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Nell to the Rescue P2](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII.
